source: Nomgar Clash (Moku, approved IP) Queen_Undead.glb, exported from the game's Unity data by Tools/rea-lab/scripts/unity_to_glb.py (see Tools/rea-lab/data/nomgar/glb/CHARACTERS.md). Copied with textures re-encoded as WebP q90 by tools/art/webp_glbs.mjs (Ruben 2026-10-26); geometry, skins, clips unchanged.
clips: picked by glTF animation extras.states (Idle/Move/Attack/Damage/Die), never by name; baked at load by src/render/skinBake.ts
note: height/footprint = rest pose (Idle frame 0) in model units, measured by the bake (bakeSkins in node, same as __mb.enemyInfo()); tuning radius = sqrt(half-width x half-depth) at the tuning height. Spider-leg dress: widest footprint of the minibosses.
